name: Alto
description: Alto is a VRChat roleplayer, streamer, and musician best known as the founder and leader of [C.H.O.D.E](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/C.H.O.D.E), a mafia-themed roleplay group he started in 2020. He also hosted a comedic game show called The Alto Show and performed as a freestyle rapper and guitarist for the community. Off-duty, he was a regular fixture at [The Black Cat](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/The_Black_Cat), doing informal performances and stand-up for other players.
